title: Give the plan critic earlier rounds' findings and planner answers
summary: Plan critic brief now carries earlier rounds' findings and the planner's answers; from round 2 it checks they were resolved and raises a new major only on changed plan parts or a defect it can show was missed before. Goal: fewer 5-round planning stops (e.g. job 20261115-202532-6mng, $14.32). Audience: Athena's planning loop and the owner Sri. Prior jobs 20261114-034034-fgwz (landed Hestia change, kept as is) and 20261115-202532-6mng (failed in planning, nothing kept) are addressed in out_of_scope.

defaults_applied.how: Unit tests for the brief and a planning-loop test; cargo test, clippy and fmt pass.
Criteria check the critic's brief content in a real planning round, not wiring.
The history is supplied by code in the brief, not by prose asking the critic to remember.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs (critic_brief at line 185, CriticInputs), crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (CriticInputs tests, line 2859), crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs and run/mod.rs (where CriticInputs is built per round). The critic prompt is crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md (244 tokens of room). No record or data file is added under crates/, so no check_record_file/AnyRecord change; Critique records already store findings per round.
Existing code: crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs and the stored Critique records are reused and extended; no new storage.
Round 1 brief is unchanged; from round 2 the brief lists each earlier round's findings (severity, location, text) and the planner's revision notes or answers.
Adds no refusal or admission rule: the critic gets more information. No past readings are newly refused (expected 0% of newly refused readings).
Does not change the 'any major forces another round' rule or the 5-round cap; only what the critic sees and is told to check.
Prompt edit is limited to critic.md, which has room; no other prompt file grows.
Changelog entry is added to CHANGELOG.md by default.

acceptance_criteria.text: A planning-loop test in crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs (run with `cargo test -p athena-cli --test job_plan`) runs two rounds through the real planning path and asserts the round-2 critic brief contains round 1's findings and the planner's answer, and the round-1 brief contains none. It fails on the code before the change.

A unit test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (run with `cargo test -p athena-context`) asserts critic_brief lists earlier findings and answers when given and is identical to today's output when there are none.

crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md tells the critic that from round 2 it must check each earlier finding was resolved and raise a new major only on parts the plan changed or a defect it can show was missed before; the diff adds no refusal rule.
crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs builds the critic's history from the stored critiques of the same job and the planner's revision output, with no new record type.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test pass on the final tree (Athena's recorded checks).

CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change; the decision is recorded in a new appended decision in docs/decisions.md with a Provenance bullet, with no edit to existing entries, and no governance file, workflow or records/ changes.

out_of_scope: Job 20261114-034034-fgwz (landed, pass): its candidate files crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs and CHANGELOG.md are kept as landed; this job changes hestia.rs not at all, and adds only a new CHANGELOG entry.

Job 20261115-202532-6mng (failed in planning, no candidate): its repair-loop plan (send_back.rs, producer.rs, verification.rs, verify.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, drain.rs, scope_guard.rs, retry.rs) is dropped, not redone; its round-5 findings do not apply to this change.
New refusal rules, changing the 5-round cap or the any-major-forces-a-round rule, planner prompt changes.
The other plan-a steps (queue ordering, backlog hold, weekly metrics) and review findings other than critic memory.
athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, records/ and owner files.
departures: Hard pipeline change touching planner loop and brief builders; higher cost than the reference median.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time: plans stopped after 5 rounds repeat earlier findings (37 jobs, $14.32 for 20261115-202532-6mng).
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline: how the plan critic judges plans and what forces further planning rounds.
